technical-summary: bc-serve quality takes --lab-experiment FILE, a forced placement schedule (placement only, validated whole before any plan with the manifest's own rules). The run measures afresh on the production plan, writes a lab-profile manifest carrying the schedule (named store untouched), and after scoring asks helper0 for its report and fails unless every transaction committed; the forced_placement event records counts and resolved swaps. Every quality run writes owner-map.json to its run dir. serve and start still have no such option.
user-summary-candidate: bc-serve quality can score a run with forced expert placement swaps applied, and writes the owner map it ran with.
